title: Visual sales-order report field and filter designer
description: User scene: from the sales-order page, an authorized user opens a visual designer, chooses allowed fields and filters, and previews results. Use only the scoped API from ERP-112 and existing ERP login/menu context. Show authorization, invalid request, empty result, and network failures without exposing hidden data. Preview is read-only and recorded by the existing request audit; no arbitrary SQL, database writes, migration, real database execution, secret/.env change, or deployment. Verify with script checks and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: The sales-order page opens a field chooser and date/customer/status/currency filters populated only by the ERP-112 catalog; no free-form SQL or field names are accepted.
Preview sends the selected bounded request to ERP-112 and safely renders returned column names and cells; loading, empty, authorization and network failures are visible without writes.
Automated UI logic tests verify selection, request bounds, safe cell rendering and failures; document user steps and run node syntax/test checks plus safe build/test.
